why: owner 27 Nov: 1.2.2 draft after the real merge of the auction house fix (0502 and 0505 did not carry the code)

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.2.2-beta (draft) for WoW Forever 1.60.1 (game build 71139)

Fixed
- Auction house: on every click the texts were English for a moment, then Persian. The text of a button is written by the button itself, which our hook did not see, so the English stood until the next scan. The button's own text writes are now caught in the same frame, so no English is drawn. The same fix covers every other window with buttons. A window that is shown is also scanned one frame later, not 50 ms.
- The Locale_UI3 file was missing from the load list, and the Auras module path had a doubled backslash. Both fixed.

New
- The game's windows page has its own switch for the auction house (AH). Merchants, trainers and professions stay in their own group.
- The texts of your report: the character statistics page (wealth, auctions, gold, weapons, resistances, transfer log), equipment icons, the reputation list (Stormwind, Ironforge, Darnassus, Booty Bay, Ratchet, Everlook, Gadgetzan, Gnomeregan Exiles, Steamwheedle Cartel, Bloodsail Buccaneers, Powderfuse), the currency list, the game menu New tag.
- The red line 'Must have a Fishing Pole equipped', the two profession descriptions (fishing camp, cooking) and the spell name Bait and Tackle.

This build is for testing in game. Nothing of the game is written, and nothing runs in combat.

Everything from 1.2.1 is included.
